articles.title: This Spider Pretends to Be a Mushroom — and Scientists Almost Missed It!
articles.summary: A spider in the Amazon looks exactly like a fungus that kills spiders. It stays super still on leaves, tricking predators and prey. Scientists first thought it was a mushroom!

articles.title: Warframe's New Update Lets You Choose Between Two Sons — From Different Universes!
articles.summary: In the game Warframe, a villain named Stalker now has twin sons from parallel timelines. Players must deal with both, and the update brings back epic space battles with huge spaceships called Railjacks.

articles.title: Could Humans Regrow Limbs? Scientists Find a Hidden 'Repair Switch'
articles.summary: Scientists at Texas A&M made mice regrow bone and joints using a two-step treatment. They didn't add stem cells — they just told the body's own cells to build instead of scar. Humans might have the same hidden power.
